headlineTrade.title: Ravens acquire C Cam Jurgens from the Eagles
headlineTrade.profile: 27, two-time Pro Bowler, under contract through 2029 ($17M AAV).
headlineTrade.status: In concussion protocol. Per Schefter (via journal), expected to debut next week vs Cleveland — not at Atlanta.
headlineTrade.olPlan: Ioane moves back to RG and Simpson plays LG. Three veteran centers (Pinter, Gwyn, Pocic) are on IR.
headlineTrade.note: Biggest Ravens trade since Roquan Smith.

lamarTimeline.title: Ankle injured vs Titans
lamarTimeline.text: Hurt left ankle on a sack (Jermaine Johnson) on the last offensive snap of the first half; did not return. Left in a walking boot. Stats before exit: 15/20, 222 yards, 2 TDs.

lamarTimeline.title: No MRI result public yet
lamarTimeline.text: Minter Mon: "I don't know the chances yet… I really don't think it's going to be crazy long-term." If Lamar can't go, Huntley starts (5–6 as fill-in).

lamarTimeline.title: MRI: left ankle sprain; outside chance for Sunday
lamarTimeline.text: Rapoport/ESPN: left ankle sprain, "outside chance" to play Sunday; could miss multiple games; not considered long-term / shouldn't need surgery. Huntley gets first-team reps. Line swung from BAL -6 (lookahead) to BAL +3 (9-point swing); total 46.5 → 43.5. Journal notes Ravens 6–11 without Lamar since 2019.

lamarTimeline.title: DNP Wednesday; unconventional sprain
lamarTimeline.text: Did not practice; skipped usual Wed media. Rapoport: sprain "unconventional" — neither low nor high ankle. Still "outside chance" for Sunday. Minter: "There is a lot of time between now and Sunday… When he is ready to play, he will be ready to play." Huntley and rookie Joe Fagnano took QB reps.

filmNotesLastGame.game: Week 4 · TEN @ BAL · Sun Oct 4, 2026 · Final BAL 24, TEN 18
bullets: Led 24–7 at halftime; scored 0 in the second half. TEN within 6 on Cam Ward 3-yd TD to Wan'Dale Robinson + 2-pt with 1:12 left; Malaki Starks recovered the onside kick.
Snapped a four-game home losing streak.
Tyler Loop: 64-yard FG as first half expired — career long, longest ever at M&T, 2nd-longest in franchise history.
Zay Flowers: 8/118/1 TD (19-yd score; catches of 52 and 23).
Mark Andrews: 3-yd TD capping a 98-yard drive after TEN turned it over on downs at the BAL 2.
Derrick Henry: 23/73/1 TD vs former team; first player since 2015 with 7 rush TDs in first four games.
Defense: Trenton Simpson first career INT; Kyle Hamilton FF; Madubuike stuffed 4th-and-goal; rookie Ethan Burke first sack.
Tyler Huntley: 8/9 for 63 yards in relief after Lamar's exit.
Also left and did not return: Humphrey (calf), Smythe (Achilles), Vorhees (foot). Stanley (toe) returned after missing Week 3.
